query: Prepare a one-page briefing for a meeting with Stripe on 17 November 2026. Cover what changed in the last 30 days (news, launches, hires, deals), cite a source URL for every fact, and end with three open questions to ask.
briefing:
# Pre-Meeting Briefing: Stripe, 17 November 2026

**Scope:** Developments from roughly 17 October to 17 November 2026, based only on the search results provided. Two results need verification before the meeting (see Deals).

## Deals

- **Reported acquisition by Globex Corporation.** A 15 Nov 2026 item reports that a company has agreed to be acquired by Globex Corporation for $9.4 billion, citing people familiar with the matter, with closing expected next quarter. The item does not name the company. Treat it as unconfirmed for Stripe until the parties are verified (https://wire-briefs.example/deals/acquisition-announced).
- **Reported PayPal bid.** A 9 Nov 2026 roundup says reports in several outlets claim Stripe and Advent International bid more than $53 billion for PayPal. The source is a secondary summary and gives no primary confirmation (https://www.financexmagazine.com/post/stablecoins-storm-the-rails-swift-builds-a-blockchain-and-wero-hits-52-million-payments-just-had).
- **Stablecoin prototype.** The same roundup, citing CoinGape, says Stripe is building a new stablecoin prototype that combines Bridge's issuance and settlement with Stripe's payments stack. It describes the 2025 Bridge purchase (reported at $1.1 billion) as background (https://www.financexmagazine.com/post/stablecoins-storm-the-rails-swift-builds-a-blockchain-and-wero-hits-52-million-payments-just-had).

## Launches

- **Stablecoin payouts to crypto wallets.** Stripe's Global Payouts product added a wallet capability in public preview in early November 2026, letting US businesses send stablecoin payouts to crypto wallets in 160+ markets (https://cryptonews.net/news/market/33703716).
- **Link by Stripe in MiniPay.** A CoinMarketCal listing scheduled the MiniPay integration for 12 Nov 2026. It adds a fiat onramp for MiniPay's 20+ million wallets, letting EU and US users buy stablecoins in one click on Celo (https://www.tradingview.com/news/coinmarketcal:ce753058b094b:0-celo-minipay-integrates-link-by-stripe-for-one-click-stablecoin-purchases-12-nov-2026).

## Hires

- No hiring news was found in the results.

## Context

- **AI agents and payments.** A WSJ report from 13 Nov 2026 covers personal AI assistants (including Meta's) now able to make purchases for cardholders. The article does not mention Stripe (https://www.wsj.com/finance/ai-bots-are-using-credit-cards-banks-are-racing-to-keep-up-c30dda30).
- **Company profile.** A Stripe profile lists 2026 acquisitions of Clerky (undisclosed, 1 Aug 2026), OpenRouter ($7.50B, 1 Aug 2026), and Valora (undisclosed, 1 Dec 2025). The profile is undated (https://tavily.com/knowledge/company/igPwhNOUwEGy).

## Open questions

1. Is Stripe a party to the reported Globex acquisition, and if not, can you confirm Stripe's position on the reported $53 billion PayPal bid?
2. What is the timeline for moving the stablecoin wallet payouts from public preview to general availability, and how will the new prototype build on Bridge?
3. How do Stripe's stablecoin and AI-agent payment plans fit together, and where are you seeing the most demand from enterprise customers?
